*[[Syrian Civil War]]:
**The [[Israeli Air Force]] launches several air strikes on Syrian military sites, killing one Syrian soldier and wounding seven others, in retaliation for a bombing that wounded four of its troops in the [[Golan Heights]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-26641815 (BBC News)]
*Two [[Egypt]]ian army officers and five militants are killed during a warehouse raid in [[Qalyubia Governorate|Qalyubiya]] province north of [[Cairo]]. [https://www.npr.org/templates/story/story.php?storyId=291317298 (NPR)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-26643502 (BBC News)]
